APPLICATION.ABOVE_N_MAX: U_C = V_hat_A * c_env(class, n_max) (constant; pre-declared extrapolation rule)
APPLICATION.WITHIN: U_C = V_hat_A * c_env(class, largest calibrated size <= n)

CANDIDATE_C.DECISION_SPLIT: EVAL only; never used for fitting or tuning
CANDIDATE_C.ENVELOPE: c_env(class, n_i) = max_{j>=i} c_raw(class, n_j) (suffix maximum; non-increasing in n)
CANDIDATE_C.POOL: all MUST cells of the class at the calibrated size (all dependence/tail/ICC/size/scale levels); STRESS and OUT_OF_DOMAIN excluded
CANDIDATE_C.RAW_FACTOR: order statistic of rank ceil(0.99*M) of the M pooled ratios (higher quantile, no interpolation)

CANDIDATE_SELECTION.APPLIES_TO: every candidate-decisive COVERAGE and UTILITY check of A, B, C (one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson)
CANDIDATE_SELECTION.WITHIN_CANDIDATE: intersection-union over MUST cells; no further adjustment

COVERAGE_RULE.ELSE: ESCALATE Stage A -> Stage B; after Stage B CALIBRATION_INDETERMINATE
COVERAGE_RULE.FAIL: one-sided CP lower bound of the miss rate > MISS_UNACCEPTABLE
COVERAGE_RULE.PASS: one-sided CP upper bound of the miss rate <= MISS_TARGET
COVERAGE_RULE.REGIONS_DISJOINT_PROOF: cp_lower <= misses/n <= cp_upper, so lower > 0.02 implies upper > 0.01

ELIGIBILITY.ELIGIBLE: COVERAGE PASS on all MUST cells AND UTILITY PASS (frontier <= REALISTIC_MAX for every MUST class) AND no execution-error or CALIBRATION_INDETERMINATE cell

EXACTNESS_LANGUAGE.A_EXACT_ONLY_IN: independent Gaussian equal-variance cells: F1/F2 phi=0 GAUSS; F3 EQUAL phi_G=0 GAUSS; F4 HOMO phi_e=0 GAUSS
EXACTNESS_LANGUAGE.B: explicitly approximate; right to use comes only from independent EVAL coverage

OWNER_DECISION: calibration freeze 4c5dcee accepted as audit artifact; execution NOT authorized; amendment items 1-9 (coverage rule, candidate-selection alpha, eligibility, target variance objects, exactness language, Candidate C definition, information/outcome terminology, Run 1 relationship, artifacts)

RUN1_RELATIONSHIP.RUN1_DOES_NOT_VALIDATE: a real exposed estimator (none existed in GV0R02 V0-V2)
RUN1_RELATIONSHIP.RUN1_VALIDATES: floor behaviour conditional on controlled q = VAR_EXPOSED_ESTIMATE / VAR_TRUE
RUN1_RELATIONSHIP.THIS_UNIT: separate prerequisite on the operational compiler path; a PASS adopts nothing by itself

RUN1_S4_COMPATIBILITY.CONSEQUENCE: if a clustered candidate is accepted, downstream compiler validation for CLUSTERED must be separate/revalidated under the cluster-level planning object
RUN1_S4_COMPATIBILITY.RUN1_S4_OBJECT: per-hour (per-observation) variance with a separate DEFF = 1 + (m-1) ICC term

TARGET_VARIANCE_OBJECT.CLUSTERED: variance of the independent cluster-level mean/statistic (long-run across ordered clusters); NOT the marginal per-hour variance
TARGET_VARIANCE_OBJECT.PAIRED_UNITS: variance of the paired difference of one unit (long-run across units)
TARGET_VARIANCE_OBJECT.RARE_EVENT: variance of the venue-averaged event statistic (long-run across ordered events)
TARGET_VARIANCE_OBJECT.TWO_SAMPLE: variance of one observation within an arm (long-run, within-arm serial dependence included)

TERMINOLOGY.COMPILE_TIME_INFORMATION: NO_EVALUATION_WINDOW_OUTCOMES_AVAILABLE (declared exposed PIT-legal surface and its counts/statistics only; evaluation/holdout outcomes unavailable; every read is an exposure-ledger row under contract V2 draft section 7)
